answer: Independent underwriters price the risk of a seat proving to be a clone and pay the network when it does. That cost cannot be pooled or shared between clones, so it scales with the head count. The whisper is the premium, the jetty the underwriting pool that pays on a clone proof, and the zenith the correlated funding that sets the price; the whisper scales with the zenith, and the jetty only pays when the clone is actually proved.
